metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 7) and T03 (TRL 7) have realistic short development windows, but T03's planned timeline of 2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1 (zero duration) is physically implausible for any real development work, and T02 (TRL 6) requiring 2 years to completion is aggressive given its dependency chain.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (market profit maximization), which demands near-market timing, yet the roadmap consistently misses market boom windows — especially T02 completing 3.25 years after its boom — indicating the execution does not reflect the commercialization-focused mandate.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies (sensor fusion, synthetic data generation, on-device optimization) are core to the AI Vision/ADAS domain, demonstrating strong domain fit and awareness of the competitive landscape in autonomous perception systems.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대 strategy, technologies should complete within ±0.5 years of boom windows; T01 misses by 0.5yr (borderline acceptable), T03 misses by 1.75 years, and T02 catastrophically misses by 3.25 years after its boom, making the mean timing error of 1.83 years structurally unacceptable for this strategy.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are reasonable convergence candidates for the ADAS/CV domain, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence that convergence zone analysis drove the selections — the poor timing alignment with market booms further suggests market signals were not rigorously integrated.

strengths: All selected technologies are firmly within the AI Vision/ADAS core domain, ensuring the company competes from a position of established capability.
Budget is fully utilized with zero violation, and dependency ordering is respected (T01 before T02, T01+T02 before T03).
weaknesses: T03 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), which is operationally impossible and suggests a scheduling error in the roadmap.
T02 completes 3.25 years after its market boom (2026-Q4), meaning the company will enter a mature or declining market phase — directly contradicting the 시장이익최대 strategy.
missing_technologies: Real-time edge inference accelerators (to complement on-device optimization with hardware-level support)
Perception uncertainty quantification / confidence calibration (critical for ADAS safety certification and commercialization)
investment_issues: T02 is rated Strategic tier with urgency=5 yet its roadmap scheduling makes it arrive 3.25 years late — the high urgency score is contradicted by the actual timeline allocation.
T03 has zero scheduled development duration, suggesting either a planning oversight or that it was added as an afterthought without proper resource and time allocation.
timing_issues: 시뮬레이션 기반 합성 데이터 생성 completes in 2030-Q1 but the market boom is 2026-Q4 — a 3.25-year miss that renders the investment commercially ineffective under profit-maximization strategy.
온-디바이스 모델 최적화 completes 1.75 years after its boom window (2028-Q2), missing the peak ROI window significantly.
The dependency chain forces T02 to start only after T01 completes in 2028-Q1, making it structurally impossible to hit T02's 2026-Q4 boom regardless of execution speed.
